title: Penetration Test Coordination: SIEM Export, Evidence Automation, RBAC v2, Audit Logs
body:
Purpose and scope:
This doc is the working plan for the upcoming external penetration test (calendar window: 2025-02-24 to 2025-02-28). It focuses on coordination, evidence collection automation, SIEM export requirements, and RBAC v2 / audit log coverage. Intended audience: SecOps, Infra, Platform, Product Security reviewers, and the external pentest vendor.

High-level objectives:
- Validate perimeter and internal controls for hosted API, Redwood Dedicated control plane, and Private (VPC) deployments.
- Verify RBAC v2 implementation enforces least privilege for admin/svc accounts.
- Confirm audit log schema captures key telemetry for SIEM ingestion and threat hunting.
- Exercise evidence automation to produce tamper-evident bundles for compliance.

In-scope systems (internal):
- API ingress layer (hosted-api cluster, public LB endpoints)
- Control plane services (model registry, rollout manager, billing)
- Serving runtime components in Dedicated: GPU nodes, inference proxies, kv-cache services
- Private deployment installer and management endpoints (VPC connectors)
- Identity and Access layer (RBAC v2 service, IAM sync, SSO integrations)
- Audit logging pipeline (logging agents -> log-aggregator -> SIEM exporters)
- Observability stack endpoints used by Redwood Console (tracing ingest, metrics endpoints)

Out-of-scope (for this pen test):
- Customer-managed on-prem model weights (air-gapped infra)
- Third-party CDN providers beyond edge configuration validation

Coordination notes (vendor rules):
- Safe-hours for noisy testing: 03:00–09:00 UTC only for high-rate scanning.
- No destructive operations against production databases. If simulated DB tests are required, use staging mirror (staging-redwood-pen).
- All test cases must be approved by SecOps leads 48h before execution.

RBAC v2 specific checklist for testers:
- Evaluate role definitions vs. least-privilege baseline (admin, infra-ops, model-onboard, billing-reader, svc-token).
- Test privilege escalation paths from svc-token roles and default service accounts.
- Verify role binding propagation to Dedicated pools and Private control plane connectors.
- Check audit events are emitted for role/binding changes, token creation, and token deletion.
- Confirm RBAC policy fallback behavior on control plane failover.

Audit log schema (required fields):
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- event_id (uuid v4)
- request_id (tracing id if present)
- principal_id (user|service id)
- principal_type (user|service|external)
- action (string, e.g., model.deploy, token.create, rbac.bind)
- resource (resource path: project/{id}/model/{id})
- outcome (success|failure|partial)
- client_ip
- user_agent
- region
- model_family (if applicable)
- token_scopes (redacted)
- change_summary (for config changes, short text)
- redaction_marker (boolean) — high-level flag to indicate PII redaction applied
- signature (HMAC-SHA256) — optional field added by log-shipping agent for tamper-evidence

Minimal SIEM export requirements:
- Transport: TLS-encrypted JSON over TCP (preferred) or HTTPS POST; support for syslog/CEF if vendor requires.
- Batching allowed but max delay <= 10s for security-critical events (rbac changes, token ops).
- Backpressure/Retry policy: keep 48h of local buffered logs when SIEM unreachable; alert SecOps after 30m.
- Field mapping: ensure event_id maps to SIEM transaction_id; request_id preserved as trace id.
- Sample flattened payload (single-line JSON for shipping):
  {"timestamp":"2025-02-14T14:02:07Z","event_id":"7a1c3a0e-1f4c-4d2a-9b6f-2b6a9e0b7c8d","request_id":"trace-4f2b","principal_id":"svc-token-analytics","principal_type":"service","action":"token.create","resource":"/org/123/svc/analytics","outcome":"success","client_ip":"52.11.142.8","region":"us-west-2","redaction_marker":"true","signature":"hmac:abcd..."}

Evidence automation and tamper-evident bundles:
- Goal: automate ingestion and packaging of artifacts required by vendor and compliance audits. Artifacts include: logs (per service), host snapshots, container image digests, kube manifests, RBAC policy dumps, token audit entries, SIEM ingestion confirmations.
- Storage: write-only S3 path: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/pen-tests/2025-02-24/vendor-a/ (server-side-encryption, KMS key: sec-pen-2025).
- Bundle format: gzipped tar with manifest.json (manifest must include checksums for each file and HMAC of manifest signed by KMS-derived key).
- Automation runner: repo infra/scripts/pen-test-evidence-collector (linked in linked_artifacts). Workflow steps: collect -> normalize -> redact (PII rules) -> sign -> upload -> notify Slack + Jira ticket update.
- Redaction rules: redact full API keys, last 4 chars of tokens, IP addresses when customer-owned; leave service internal IPs. Mark any skipped items in manifest.skipped_reasons.

Sample automated checklist (run by infra scripts):
1) snapshot: kubectl get all --all-namespaces -o yaml -> saved as cluster-state-<ts>.yaml
2) dump RBAC: rbac-v2 dump -> rbac-dump-<ts>.json
3) logs: pull last 72h from log-aggregator for target services -> logs-service-<name>-<ts>.ndjson
4) docker images: docker inspect for inference, runtime, agent -> images-list-<ts>.json
5) SIEM export proof: last 24h export ack list -> siem-ingest-acks-<ts>.csv
6) sign and upload bundles, attach checksum into SEC-314 ticket.

Findings summary (initial vendor report placeholder):
- F1 (High): RBAC v2 - default svc-token role allows container exec into inference proxy when bound to legacy svc account. Impact: potential lateral movement from data-plane to control-plane. Tentative JIRA: SEC-345. Owner: infra-ops. ETA mitigation: 2025-03-05. Verification steps: remove legacy binding in staging, run attacker simulation (vendor) and confirm no exec path.
- F2 (Medium): Audit pipeline - certain resource-change events (model.rollback, rollout.create) are emitted without request_id causing gaps in traceability. JIRA: SEC-346. Owner: observability. ETA: 2025-03-10. Remediation: include request_id in event formatter; reprocess last 7 days to fill gaps where possible.
- F3 (Medium): SIEM export - batching configuration occasionally drops signature field when backpressure triggers legacy shipper (legacy-syslog). JIRA: INFRA-228. Owner: logging-team. ETA: 2025-03-12. Remediation: pin new shipper version that enforces signature copy.
- F4 (Low): Evidence automation - manifest HMAC not consistently applied when bundle size > 2GB. JIRA: SEC-347. Owner: sec-automation. ETA: 2025-03-02. Fix: stream HMAC computation to avoid memory spikes.

Remediation plan template (for each finding):
- short_description: single-line summary
- severity: high|medium|low
- impact_area: e.g., RBAC, logging, SIEM
- owner: person/team
- mitigation_steps: numbered steps with env-specific notes (staging first, then prod)
- verification_criteria: clear pass/fail checks vendor can rerun
- jira_ticket: e.g., SEC-345
- target_date: YYYY-MM-DD

Example remediation entry (F1):
- short_description: "Restrict default svc-token role to prevent container exec by legacy svc accounts"
- severity: "high"
- impact_area: "RBAC v2, control-plane"
- owner: "infra-ops"
- mitigation_steps: "1) Add deny rule for container.exec on control-plane namespaces. 2) Update role-binding migrations to remove legacy svc accounts. 3) Deploy to staging and run vendor attack scenario. 4) Roll out to prod with canary."
- verification_criteria: "Vendor cannot reproduce exec path; audit events show denied attempts with correct event_id and request_id."
- jira_ticket: "SEC-345"
- target_date: "2025-03-05"

Post-test actions and evidence handoff:
- Deliverable bundle to vendor: signed evidence tar.gz, manifest.json, verification checklist.
- Post-test debrief: secure video call within 48h to walk through critical findings.
- Retest window: vendor to retest fixes within 2–3 weeks; longer engagement optional for validation of infra changes.

Operational runbook snippets (quick refs):
- How to trigger evidence collector: ./scripts/collect-evidence --test-window 2025-02-24..2025-02-28 --target vendor-a --output s3://redwood-sec-evidence/pen-tests/2025-02-24/vendor-a/
- How to validate SIEM mapping: run ./tools/siem-validate --sample events.json --mapping rules/siem-mapping.yml

Open questions / TODOs (working):
- Confirm vendor supports TLS+JSON over TCP ingestion; fallback needed for legacy syslog? (ACTION: Ethan)
- Decide retention policy for pen-test bundles (proposed 2 years encrypted). (ACTION: Lina)
- Finalize HMAC key rotation schedule used by evidence collector (ACTION: Maya)

Contacts and escalation matrix:

- Audit log schema PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/579

Notes to reviewers: this is a working draft — expect iterative updates as vendor scoping call completes. Add comments inline or ping @maya in #sec-pen-test-2025 for urgent changes.
